title: nutty dense american bean sprouts wrap
description: a satisfying, one-pot dish featuring bean sprouts, grilled to perfection in a corn husk wrap.
instructions: heat grapeseed oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
add rice and cook until lightly toasted, about 3 minutes.
add black bean sprouts, salt, pepper, and nutmeg, and stir to combine.
cover skillet with a lid and cook for 5 minutes, or until sprouts are tender.
add shredded carrot, roasted red pepper, and maple syrup, and stir to combine.
toss in crushed peanuts and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
warm corn husks by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
place 1/2 cup of the rice and sprouts mixture onto the center of each corn husk, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
fold the bottom edge of each husk up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll into a neat package.
place seam-side down on a plate and serve immediately.
